output.summary: A flowering perennial and subshrub native to the steppes and hills of southwestern and central Asia. It has aromatic gray-green leaves and showy blue-to-violet flowers from midsummer into autumn. Its flowers are eaten in salads in parts of Afghanistan and Pakistan, including Kashmir, where they add a sweet flavor.
